name: Tree Evaluation with Bilinear Interpolation and VQ Residuals
definition: An algorithm to evaluate a signal value at a point x by traversing an adaptive quadtree structure, using bilinear interpolation of node values and Vector Quantization (VQ) residuals to reconstruct the signal.
summary: Tree Evaluation with Bilinear Interpolation and VQ Residuals evaluates 2D signals by traversing an adaptive quadtree using bilinear interpolation and Vector Quantization residuals, distinguishing itself from 3D trilinear methods.
